English: Target Patch
A makeshift patch of earth with simple wooden stakes and bundled straw for practicing basic bow skills.
Straw Bale Range
A simple range using straw bales and basic markers, allowing clansmen to train with bows in an organized, if still primitive, setting.
Basic Archery Lane
A cleared and measured archery lane with marked distances and simple windbreaks, enabling more disciplined training.
Horse Archer Field
A broad field designed for practicing archery from horseback, with moving targets and riding lanes for nomad warriors.
Advanced Target Range
A sophisticated range with distance markers, elevated platforms, and rotating targets for both foot and mounted archers.
Composite Bow Yard
A dedicated yard for the crafting, maintenance, and advanced training with composite bows, raising standards for the entire clan.
Expert Archer Track
A large, well-prepared circuit with challenging obstacles and moving targets designed to produce elite archers and horse archers.
Mounted Shooting Gallery
A specialized gallery for advanced mounted archery, with wheeled targets and elaborate training courses for seasoned warriors.
Sharpshooter Park
An expansive, professionally maintained park for elite archers—offering long-range lanes, wind towers, and communal competitions.
Master Archer Arena
A legendary arena for clan-wide tournaments, with permanent stone grandstands, advanced facilities, and a tradition of producing peerless archers.
